WorkSync 0.4.0 lets a group work on the same projects through a folder on
the shared drive, and adds tasks and discussions.

## Download

| System                    | File                              |
| ------------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| Windows (64-bit)          | `WorkSync-win32-x64-0.4.0.zip`    |
| macOS (Apple silicon)     | `WorkSync-darwin-arm64-0.4.0.zip` |
| Linux (no install)        | `WorkSync-linux-x64-0.4.0.zip`    |
| Linux, Debian or Ubuntu   | `worksync_0.4.0_amd64.deb`        |
| Linux, Fedora or openSUSE | `worksync-0.4.0-1.x86_64.rpm`     |

- **Windows:** unzip into a folder on a local drive and run `worksync.exe`.
  Nothing is installed. To update, unzip the new version in the same place as
  the old one: your data is in the `WorkSync-data` folder next to it and stays.
- **macOS:** unzip and move `WorkSync.app` to Applications.
- **Linux:** unzip and run `worksync`, or install the package.

The builds aren't code signed yet, so Windows and macOS warn the first time.
See [Download and run](https://github.com/KelvinNguyen97/WorkSync#download-and-run)
for how to open the app anyway. Your data from 0.3.0 is kept and upgraded; a
backup is made first.

## Changed: tasks are now called tickets

What a project tracks is now a **ticket** (チケット), on every screen, in
reports and in the AI copy-paste format. Your data is unchanged. **My tasks**
keeps its name, the published file is still `tasks.xlsx`, and AI answers in
the old `=== TASK` form are still read.

## New

- **Tasks.** Small jobs in a project, each for one person, with a due date.
  - Add one in a line: `Test on Stg @Suzuki 11/21 #025` sets who, when and
    the ticket.
  - One click on the box marks a task Done; the word beside it switches
    To do and Doing.
  - A ticket shows its tasks and how many are done, and so does the Ticket
    briefs report.
  - **My tasks** also lists the project tasks assigned to you, with
    reminders. A personal to-do can be moved into a project.
- **Discussions.** Tickets to talk a topic through: comments, replies,
  @mentions, files and pasted images (25 MB each), and comments marked as
  decisions.
  - A discussion links to the progress ticket with the same number: WorkSync
    asks when you give it that number, or link from either side.
  - **Summarize into progress** builds a request from the comments since the
    last summary. Paste it into your AI chat, paste the answer back, and tick
    the changes to apply. Action items can become tasks.
  - **Update progress from discussions** does this for every linked
    discussion with new comments, in batches.
- **Workspaces: work together without a server.** Choose **Workspaces…** in
  the sidebar.
  - Create a workspace in a folder on the shared drive and share projects in
    it. Changes show on the others' screens in a few seconds.
  - No accounts or passwords. A colleague picks the folder and gets a
    6-digit code; any member checks the code with them and lets them in.
  - Everything in the folder is encrypted, and each PC writes only its own
    files, so the shared drive can't mix them up.
  - Keep working when the folder can't be reached; changes are sent when it
    is back. The sidebar shows Online or Offline.
  - Notices and Windows notifications when you are given a task or
    mentioned. Two tickets with the same number are marked **Number clash**
    for you to settle.
  - Your notes on a ticket, your next action, My tasks, settings and the
    link to the customer's file stay on your PC.
  - Remove a member or one of their PCs, and save a recovery file in case
    every member's PC is lost.
- **Reports:** choose which parts the Progress report and Ticket briefs
  include.
- **Releases:** the timeline shows one line per release, opened on a click,
  and the import keeps rows with no file name as "No info".

## Fixed

- With the dark theme on a Mac set to Light, the title bar is readable.
- Clicking a small picture in a note opens it instead of asking to remove it.
- Japanese: the language names in project settings and other gaps.

## Good to know about workspaces

Workspaces are new: try one with a test project first.

- One person links the customer's Excel file; the others get its tickets
  through the workspace.
- A ticket deleted in a shared project is deleted for everyone, and there is
  no Trash yet.
- A `.worksync` export doesn't carry tasks or discussions yet.
- Old change files in the workspace folder aren't cleaned up yet.
- When two people change the same field, the later change wins and the
  other person gets a notice.

Please report problems on the
[Issues page](https://github.com/KelvinNguyen97/WorkSync/issues).
